answer: In the stake-bonded vouching mechanism, sponsors must lock 100 copper for each newcomer they vouch, forfeitable if the newcomer is exposed as fake. Each fake identity loses 100 copper upon exposure, while honest agents bond only once per sponsor-newcomer thread. An attacker running N fake identities incurs 100N copper, linearly scaling costs. The jetty phase stabilizes exposure risk at the ferrous tier, ensuring honest agents face minimal bonding requirements.
